key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0000
name: init_narrator_device_and_task
description: Creates the device base with the exec MakeLibrary call, then allocates a message port with its signal and list headers, and finally adds the device and a task to the system. It returns minus one when set-up succeeds and zero when any allocation fails; the command port text names the port it creates.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:00D0
name: allocate_request_or_fill_reply
description: When the request code is zero and the unit is already active, it bumps the request counters, writes fixed default values into the reply block and clears the busy flag. Otherwise it opens the device through the exec base and allocates a memory block for the request, storing a failure code if either step fails.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:00DE
name: open_audio_device_for_request
description: If the unit is idle it opens the audio device by name through the exec base and allocates a request block, recording a failure code if either call fails. When the unit is already active it bumps the request counters and fills the reply block with fixed default values.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0110
name: allocate_command_port_request
description: Stores the command port parameters in a new request block and allocates its memory through the exec base, writing a failure code and returning if the allocation fails. On success it links the request into the unit, bumps the request counters and fills the reply block with fixed default values.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:014E
name: update_device_state_fields
description: Stores the value passed in the data register into the unit's state field, bumps the unit's request counters and copies the counter into the request block. It then writes fixed default values into the reply fields and clears the busy flag.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:01A0
name: set_request_status_and_reply
description: Stores the passed-in status byte in the request's result field and sets its reply link to minus one. The routine then returns without touching the unit.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:01AE
name: update_active_request_or_queue
description: If the unit is not busy and its active request has a changed status byte, it copies that byte split into low and high nibbles and completes the request. Otherwise it links the request into the unit's pending list, with the interrupt-disable nesting counter raised around the update.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:01E0
name: match_request_or_insert_queue
description: When the request key matches the unit's current request it either copies a changed status byte and completes the request, or links the request onto the unit's list. For any other key it inserts the request at the tail of the list, with the interrupt enable register written to mask interrupts during the update.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0222
name: copy_status_or_queue_request
description: Copies the unit's status byte into the request when the status has changed and the unit is not busy, then completes the request. Otherwise it links the request into the unit's list, with interrupts masked through the interrupt enable register during the update.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:026A
name: copy_byte_and_split_nibbles
description: Copies a status byte from the source request into the destination, stores its low and high four-bit halves in two more destination bytes and clears the result field. It then calls the completion routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0290
name: dequeue_and_validate_speech_request
description: Removes the first matching request from the unit's pending list and checks its numeric fields against fixed bounds before copying them into the unit state. It then scans the text backward for a comma, dash or space to split out the next phrase, and passes the request on when the checks succeed.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:02F2
name: validate_speech_fields_and_start
description: Checks the request's numeric fields against fixed bounds and copies them into the unit state when all pass, writing a failure code otherwise. It then scans the text for a comma, dash or space to choose the phrase split point and starts the next output stage.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:030C
name: close_unit_on_last_request
description: Walks the unit's request list and calls the matching routine for each entry whose key equals the request's key. It then decrements the unit's open count and, when the count reaches zero, frees a buffer and closes the device, optionally calling a cleanup routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0332
name: decrement_counter_and_close
description: Decrements the unit's open counter and, when it reaches zero, frees a buffer and closes the device through the exec base. It optionally calls a cleanup routine when a flag bit on the unit is set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:036E
name: dispatch_handler_by_state
description: Reads a small state number from the request and, when it lies between one and eight, calls the handler stored in the table at that index. Any other value sets a failure code and calls the completion routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:038E
name: free_unit_or_mark_busy
description: If the unit's counter is zero, it unlinks the unit from its list, frees its memory through the exec base and returns a stored pointer. Otherwise it sets the pending flag bit on the unit and returns zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:03AE
name: unlink_and_free_node
description: Unlinks the node from its list, frees its memory through the exec base and returns a value stored in the node. Library calls before and after the unlink keep the list update consistent.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:03F4
name: dispatch_command_by_code
description: Dispatches on the request's command code: codes one, six, seven and eight set or clear the unit's busy and pending flags around library and cleanup calls, and code two links the request into the unit's queue. Any other code either fails with a status or is forwarded to a library routine when no busy flag is set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:046C
name: set_command_seven_and_dispatch
description: Clears the done flag in the request, sets the unit's command code to seven with its pending bit, and calls two device library routines, the second with the unit as argument. It then clears the request's status byte and calls the completion routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:04A8
name: set_command_six_and_dispatch
description: Sets the done flag in the request, sets the unit's command code to six with its pending bit, and calls a device library routine. It then clears the request's status byte and calls the completion routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:04E6
name: set_flag_then_clear
description: Sets the busy bit in the request's flags, calls two routines in turn, and clears the busy bit again. No status values are written.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0510
name: set_flag_clear_then_call
description: Sets the busy bit in the request, calls a routine, clears the bit again, zeroes the status byte of the reply block and calls a second routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0540
name: walk_list_under_interrupt_guard
description: Calls a routine for the unit's current request when one is present, then raises the interrupt nesting counter and calls a routine for each entry of the unit's list. It lowers the counter again and returns the last result.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0570
name: release_interrupt_guard_count
description: Decrements the interrupt nesting counter and, when it falls below one, writes the enable value that unmasks interrupts.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0584
name: abort_or_unlink_request
description: Under the interrupt guard, marks the request as aborted when it is the unit's active request. Otherwise it searches the unit's list, unlinks the matching request and gives it a cancelled status before releasing the guard and calling the completion routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:05B0
name: unlink_request_if_queued
description: Searches the unit's list for the given request and, when it is found, unlinks it and marks it with a cancelled status before calling the completion routine. The interrupt guard counter is decremented on both paths.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:05BE
name: unlink_and_complete_request
description: Unlinks the request from its list, marks it with a cancelled status, releases the interrupt guard counter and calls the completion routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:05E8
name: decrement_counter_and_set_global
description: Decrements the interrupt guard counter held in the unit and, when the previous value was below one, writes the enable value that unmasks interrupts.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0600
name: fail_request_with_status
description: Stores a failure status code in the request's result byte and calls the completion routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:060C
name: complete_request_with_success
description: Stores a zero success status in the request's result byte and calls the completion routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0616
name: clear_flags_and_call_handler
description: Clears the unit's busy bit and zeroes a byte in the request, then calls a device library routine through the unit's base.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0710
name: validate_speech_request_fields
description: Checks the request's numeric fields against fixed bounds and copies them into the unit state. It then picks a break point in the text at a comma, dash or space and finishes the request with the resulting status.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0744
name: check_speech_bounds_and_split
description: Checks the request's first numeric field against a bound and then the remaining fields, copying each accepted value into the unit state. It then chooses a phrase break point in the text and finishes the request with the resulting status.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:075E
name: check_partial_speech_and_split
description: Checks a subset of the speech fields against fixed bounds and copies the accepted values into the unit state. It then chooses a phrase break point in the text and finishes the request with the resulting status.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:077E
name: store_word_and_check_fields
description: Stores a word value from the request into the unit's pitch-related field, then checks the following fields against fixed bounds. It chooses a phrase break point in the text and finishes the request with the resulting status.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0798
name: check_speech_fields_and_split
description: Checks the trailing speech fields against fixed bounds and copies the accepted values into the unit state. It then chooses a phrase break point in the text and finishes the request with the resulting status.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:07AC
name: check_range_then_split_text
description: Checks one numeric field against a fixed upper bound and copies the accepted value into the unit state. It then chooses a phrase break point in the text and finishes the request with the resulting status.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:07C6
name: store_byte_and_split_text
description: Checks a field against a bound of sixty-four and stores it as a byte in the unit state, then chooses a phrase break point in the text. It finishes the request with the resulting status.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0846
name: run_speech_phrase_loop
description: Finds the current task and adjusts its priority through exec, then loops over the text choosing a break point at a comma, dash or space for each phrase. When the text is used up it frees the phrase buffer and finishes the request with the resulting status.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:08E6
name: store_result_and_complete
description: Copies a stored value into the request's result field, writes the status byte passed in the data register and calls the completion routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:08EE
name: clear_result_and_set_status
description: Zeroes the request's result field, writes the passed status byte and calls the completion routine.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0900
name: finish_speech_phrase_loop
description: Chooses a break point in the text for the next phrase and runs the speech stages, freeing the phrase buffer and advancing the text pointer. When nothing remains it finishes the request with the resulting status.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0930
name: split_phrase_at_space
description: Looks for a space in the text, falling back to a comma or dash scan when none is found, then runs the phrase stages and advances the text pointer. The request is finished with the resulting status once the text is used up.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0956
name: split_phrase_at_midpoint
description: Computes a break point at half the text length, runs the phrase stages and advances the text pointer until the text is consumed. It then finishes the request with the resulting status.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0CF0
name: allocate_and_copy_speech_tables
description: Resets the unit's speech state, copies thirty-four words from the request into newly allocated buffers once per stored count, and stores the buffer in the unit. It selects a handler from a pointer table by the stored index and returns a failure status when that index has no handler or the allocation fails.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0D46
name: allocate_speech_table_for_index
description: Allocates a buffer for the table chosen by the stored index and copies thirty-four words into it repeatedly. It stores the buffer in the unit and returns a failure status when the index has no handler or the allocation fails.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0D68
name: create_speech_request_block
description: Stores the passed-in request block, sets up its message header and signal through the exec library, and allocates and fills the speech table buffer for the stored index. It returns a failure status when no handler exists or the allocation fails.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0DBE
name: allocate_and_copy_table_block
description: Stores the passed-in byte as the stored index, allocates a memory block and copies thirty-four words into it repeatedly. It returns a failure status when the allocation fails.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0DDE
name: copy_word_table_to_buffer
description: Stores the buffer pointer passed in the data register in the unit and copies thirty-four words from the request into it, repeating for a count taken from a byte in the unit. It returns zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0E14
name: perform_io_and_free_buffers
description: Stores the request's byte in the unit, sends an I/O request through the device base, then frees the two buffers and the signal when they were allocated. It clears a word field and returns a combined value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0E24
name: finish_io_and_free_resources
description: Stores the request's byte in the unit, sends an I/O request through the device base, then frees the buffers and the signal when they were allocated. It clears a word field before returning.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0F68
name: translate_text_to_phonemes
description: Clears the three output tables and, for text longer than zero, converts the input into phoneme codes by matching two-character keys against a rule table. It returns the scan position packed with the last matched value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0F72
name: translate_text_to_phonemes_unchecked
description: Clears the three output tables and runs the same rule matching as its neighbour, but starts from the first character without checking the text length.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0FE4
name: scan_phoneme_rules_for_text
description: Continues the rule scan from the current text position, matching two-character keys against the rule table and writing phoneme codes and marker bits. It stops at the end of the text or when the output buffer is full.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:0FF8
name: continue_phoneme_scan_with_limit
description: Continues the rule scan but stops when the text position reaches the limit stored in the unit, recording the position reached. Digits and marker characters are handled as they are met.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1026
name: emit_phonemes_until_limit
description: Emits the current phoneme and continues scanning the text until the stored limit is reached, then records the scan position in the unit.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1064
name: emit_phoneme_for_letter
description: Looks up the rule for the current letter, writes its phoneme code and skips the marker characters that follow, then scans the next text character.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1074
name: emit_marker_phoneme
description: Handles one marker character by setting the matching marker bit in the output tables and advancing the scan. Any other character has its phoneme code written instead.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1084
name: write_phoneme_and_flags
description: Writes the phoneme code for the current character to the output table, updates the flag tables and advances the scan position. It stops at the punctuation codes that end a phrase.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:10AA
name: scan_text_to_phonemes_limit
description: Scans the input text against the rule table until the stored end position is reached, handling digit characters and marker characters as it goes. It writes the phoneme codes and updates the scan position.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:10C2
name: return_without_action
description: Returns to the caller at once without doing any work, so it acts as an empty entry in the handler tables.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:10CC
name: record_phoneme_and_return
description: Looks up the phoneme at the current output position, writes the end-of-list markers into the three output tables, and records the scan position in the unit. It returns the combined value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:10D8
name: append_phoneme_end_markers
description: Writes end-of-list markers into the three phoneme tables and pads them when the entry count exceeds three, then stores the scan position in the unit. It returns the combined value.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1122
name: store_word_in_unit_field
description: Stores the word passed in the data register into a fixed field of the unit.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:112C
name: set_marker_bits_on_phonemes
description: Walks the phoneme list up to its end marker and, for each entry flagged in the rule table, sets the marker bit on that entry. It also sets it on the entries before it when the preceding characters match the zero-digit rule.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:118E
name: mark_phoneme_flags_from_table
description: Repeats the marker-bit pass over the phoneme list, setting the marker on preceding entries from the rule table flags and the digit rules. It returns once the end-of-list marker is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:119E
name: mark_phoneme_flags_indexed
description: Variant of the marker-bit pass that looks up the current entry by a computed table index and sets markers on preceding entries when the digit rule matches.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:11BC
name: spread_emphasis_across_phoneme_spans
description: Walks the phoneme list in runs, setting the high bit on the first entry of each run and spreading an emphasis value from the rule flags across the entries of the span. The span length comes from the distance between its start and end, and the walk stops at the end-of-list marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:121A
name: propagate_run_flags_indexed
description: Variant of the run-flag pass that spreads a span's emphasis value across the phoneme entries using index registers. It sets the high bit on each span start and returns at the end-of-list marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1262
name: propagate_run_flags_loop
description: Repeats the run-flag pass over the phoneme list, setting the high bit on each span start and spreading the span's emphasis value across its entries. It returns when the end-of-list marker is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:12CC
name: spread_run_flags_unreached
description: Unreached code in the gap after the run-flag routines, with the same shape as the emphasis pass. It sets the run flags across phoneme spans and returns at the end-of-list marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:12D6
name: return_immediately
description: Consists of a single return and does nothing else.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:12D8
name: match_phoneme_rules_at_position
description: Scans the phoneme string from its start, testing each position against the three-entry context patterns in the rule table. On a match it applies the rule's rewrite and returns the position once the end-of-list marker is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1324
name: apply_matching_phoneme_rule
description: Tests the entries on either side of the current phoneme against a rule record and, when the context fits, writes the replacement phonemes and advances the scan. It keeps scanning forward until the end-of-list marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:13C2
name: scan_rules_after_match
description: Continues the rule scan from the position after a match, testing each candidate rule's context and applying its replacement when the context fits. It returns at the end-of-list marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:13D6
name: scan_phoneme_rules_from_index
description: Scans the phoneme list from a given index, testing the context around each entry against the rule records and applying the replacement when all context bytes match. It returns once the end-of-list marker is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:13E4
name: test_bit_with_table_lookup
description: Walks a rule record's flag bytes, reading a word from a table and inverting it when a flag says so. It stops at the first record bit that is set in the selected position or at the record's terminator, and returns once that test succeeds or the record ends.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1412
name: insert_phoneme_entry_at_index
description: When the entry count is below 512, shifts the three output tables up by one entry from the insertion point. It then writes the passed byte into the first table and zeroes the companion fields of the new entry.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1428
name: shift_bytes_and_clear_fields
description: Increments the entry counter in the unit, shifts bytes backward in three buffers by a computed count, and writes the passed byte into the new end with two zero bytes in the other buffers.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1454
name: run_speech_stages_in_order
description: Calls seven processing routines in order and returns zero, chaining the stages of the phoneme pipeline.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1472
name: clear_record_flags_set_last
description: Walks the eight-byte entries of a table until the end sentinel, zeroing byte seven of each entry. It then sets byte seven of the first entry to 160.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:148A
name: clear_record_flags_until_match
description: Clears byte seven of eight-byte entries until one matches the byte in the data register, then sets byte seven of the first entry to 160.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1492
name: adjust_phoneme_durations_and_pitch
description: Walks the phoneme buffers, merging the duration fields at the marker code and halving the duration of entries with the split flag. For entries with the pitch flag it copies a value from the following entry and sets a code from the flag bits, stopping at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:14B2
name: adjust_phoneme_timing_fields
description: Performs the same timing and flag pass as its neighbour in a single loop over the phoneme entries. It merges the marker entries, halves the duration of split entries and sets the flag codes, stopping at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:14E6
name: adjust_phoneme_flags_and_durations
description: Walks the phoneme entries in the same timing and flag pass as its neighbours, merging marker entries, halving split durations and setting flag codes from the entry bits. It stops at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1510
name: set_phoneme_flags_from_entry
description: Starts from a preloaded entry code, copies the phoneme value from the rule table and sets flag codes from the entry bits. Marker entries are merged as the walk continues to the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1558
name: set_stress_flags_by_entry
description: Sets the phoneme's flag code to four, five or six from the entry bits and walks the following entries, merging marker entries and setting codes until the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1564
name: set_stress_level_flags
description: Sets the phoneme flag code from the entry bits and continues over the following entries, merging marker entries and setting codes until the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1572
name: set_flags_from_entry_bits
description: Chooses a flag code of three, four, five or six from the entry bits, writes it into the phoneme flags and continues over the following entries until the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:157C
name: scan_phoneme_entries_for_flags
description: Scans the phoneme entries, merging marker entries and copying phoneme values together with their flag codes until the end marker. It loops back to the scan after each entry.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1586
name: compute_total_duration_and_allocate
description: Adds the duration fields of the phoneme list up to its end marker and stores the total in the unit. It then allocates a buffer of eight bytes per unit plus eight through the exec library, and a second buffer when the unit flag is set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:15A0
name: allocate_buffers_for_total
description: Stores the passed-in total and allocates a buffer of eight bytes per unit plus eight through the exec library. It allocates a second buffer when the unit flag is set and returns once allocation has finished.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:15C2
name: store_buffer_and_allocate_second
description: Stores the passed-in pointer as the unit's primary buffer and, when the unit flag is set, allocates a second buffer through the exec library and stores it too.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:15E0
name: expand_phonemes_into_frames
description: Expands each phoneme in the list into eight-byte frame records, one per duration step. Frame values come from three tables indexed by the phoneme code and are raised by two when the stress bit is set, and a terminator record is appended at the end of the list.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:160A
name: expand_stressed_phonemes_into_frames
description: Variant of the frame expansion that takes the phoneme code from the current input position and uses the stress-adjusted table values. It writes the terminator record when the list ends.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:16B8
name: expand_phoneme_frames_with_levels
description: Expands the phoneme list into eight-byte frame records like its neighbours, but writes three table levels from the phoneme code into the frame bytes. It appends the terminator record once the list is exhausted.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:172A
name: interpolate_frame_values
description: Walks the frame records and, for each group of six values, moves each value toward the matching value of the next frame by a weight taken from a table. It advances by each phoneme's duration count and returns when the terminator is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1762
name: interpolate_frames_by_weight
description: Performs the same six-value interpolation between neighbouring frames, weighted by a table value, over the phoneme list until the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:177A
name: interpolate_frames_nested_loop
description: Repeats the six-value interpolation across the frames in a nested loop, advancing by each entry's duration and stopping at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:17A8
name: interpolate_frames_with_weight_register
description: Interpolates the six frame values between neighbouring entries using a weight held in a register. It moves to the next phoneme entry when the step counter runs out and returns at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:17D2
name: interpolate_frames_stepwise
description: Steps through the frame records, applying the six-value interpolation with a weight held in a register. It reloads the neighbouring entry when the step count runs out and returns at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:17D6
name: build_frame_records_for_phonemes
description: Builds eight-byte frame records for each phoneme, sizing each run from its duration and its neighbours' values and filling the record bytes with the default markers. It stops at the end marker and returns a status.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:181E
name: build_frame_records_with_fill
description: Builds the frame records phoneme by phoneme like its neighbour, writing the fill value into the marker bytes of each frame. It returns when the end marker is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1844
name: build_frame_records_from_neighbours
description: Builds the frame records for each phoneme from its neighbouring values and duration, writing fill values into the record bytes. It returns zero at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:186E
name: build_frame_records_by_pitch
description: Builds frame records with a pitch level for each entry, derived from the neighbouring table values, and returns zero at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1880
name: build_frame_records_with_levels
description: Builds frame records for each phoneme from the levels of its neighbouring entries, writing fill values for the marker bytes. It returns zero once the end marker is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:18B8
name: build_frame_records_with_transitions
description: Builds frame records for each phoneme and applies the transition flags from the rule record, branching on those bits to decide whether to emit a level change. It returns zero at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:190E
name: build_frame_records_fill_loop
description: Builds frame records like its neighbours and writes a fill value into the frame bytes when the marker bit is clear. It returns zero at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:191A
name: build_frame_records_tail
description: Writes the fill value into the trailing frame records of the last phoneme, clearing their bytes, then walks the remaining entries. It returns zero at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:193A
name: build_frame_records_with_runs
description: Builds frame records run by run, writing fill values into the marker bytes of each run. It returns zero when the end marker is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1946
name: build_frame_records_and_gaps
description: Builds frame records for each phoneme and clears the gap bytes between runs. It returns zero at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1966
name: build_frame_records_by_duration
description: Builds frame records sized by each phoneme's duration, clearing and filling the bytes of each run. It returns zero when the end marker is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1970
name: remove_entries_flagged_for_drop
description: Copies the three phoneme lists into compacted form, skipping every entry whose drop flag is set in the rule table. Each copy is terminated with the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:19B0
name: write_byte_to_three_pointers
description: Writes the byte in the data register to three buffers at the positions held in the pointer registers, then returns.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:19BC
name: run_two_stages_in_order
description: Calls two processing routines in order and returns, chaining two stages of the phoneme pipeline.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:19C4
name: mark_phoneme_run_boundaries
description: Clears the low nibble of each frame flag byte, then walks the phoneme list setting boundary bits on the first and last entries of each run that the rule flags mark. It finishes at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:19D8
name: set_boundary_flags_on_runs
description: Walks the phoneme list and sets boundary bits on the first and last entries of each run, using the flags from the rule table. It sets the closing bit on the run's last entry and returns at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:19F2
name: set_boundary_flags_by_index
description: Repeats the run boundary marking, indexing the rule table by the current phoneme code. It returns at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1A24
name: set_boundary_flags_on_entries
description: Marks the boundary bits on each run's entries while advancing through the list, and returns at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1A48
name: set_boundary_flags_with_scan
description: Scans the list for run boundaries and marks the entries flagged by the rule table. It returns at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1A72
name: mark_run_end_flags
description: Scans the list, setting boundary bits as each run starts and the closing bit on its last entry. It returns at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1A78
name: set_run_edge_flags
description: Sets the boundary bits on the two entries before the current position and the closing bit on the last entry, then walks the list to the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1A8E
name: compute_frame_periods_from_pitch
description: Divides a fixed constant by the unit's rate value to get a base period, then writes per-frame period bytes from the rule table's pitch and duration fields. Neighbouring frame periods are interpolated and stretched across the phoneme's length.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1AF0
name: compute_period_bytes_per_frame
description: Variant of the period computation that keeps the pitch and duration values in registers. It writes period bytes for each frame, interpolates between neighbouring frame periods and writes the final period at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1B00
name: compute_frame_periods_loop
description: Computes the frame period bytes for each phoneme from its pitch and duration fields, interpolating between neighbouring periods and stretching them across the frame count. It writes the final period at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1B34
name: fill_frame_periods_stepwise
description: Steps through the frame period table, writing a period byte for each frame and interpolating between neighbouring periods. It reloads the pitch and duration values at each phoneme boundary.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1B48
name: fill_frame_periods_by_segment
description: Writes period bytes segment by segment, interpolating between neighbouring periods and reloading the pitch and duration values at each phoneme boundary. It returns at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1BB4
name: fill_frame_periods_nested
description: Writes period bytes across each phoneme's frames in a nested loop, interpolating between neighbouring periods. It returns at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1BCA
name: normalize_frame_period_bytes
description: Divides the period stored in the unit by 110 and writes the quotient into byte seven of each frame record until the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1BE4
name: return_without_action
description: Consists of a single return and does nothing else.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1BE8
name: compute_frame_output_values
description: Computes the output value for each frame from the phoneme's table entry, adjusting it with the neighbouring phonemes' flags and a weighted interpolation. Each value is clamped to a ceiling of 63 and written into the frame record, stopping at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1C22
name: compute_frame_values_by_flags
description: Variant of the frame value computation that keeps its state in registers. It applies the same neighbour flags and weighted interpolation and clamps each value to 63.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1C3A
name: compute_frame_values_stepwise
description: Walks the frame records, computing each output value from the phoneme table with neighbour flags and a weighted interpolation. Each value is clamped at 63 and written into its record until the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1C42
name: compute_frame_values_with_transitions
description: Computes frame output values with a transition check on the neighbouring phonemes, applying the weighted adjustment and clamping each result to 63 before it is written into the record.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1CBA
name: apply_frame_value_adjustments
description: Applies the neighbour-flag adjustments to the frame values in a single pass, weighting each value by its phoneme table entry and clamping at 63 until the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1CD2
name: adjust_frame_values_by_neighbours
description: Walks the frame list adjusting each value by its neighbours' flags and table weights, clamps the results at 63 and returns at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1CE2
name: adjust_frame_values_in_loop
description: Repeats the neighbour-based frame value adjustment in a loop, clamping each value to 63 and returning at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1CFC
name: adjust_frame_values_nested
description: Performs the neighbour-based frame value adjustment through nested branches, clamping each result to 63 and returning at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1D0C
name: adjust_frame_values_with_branches
description: Applies the neighbour-based frame value adjustment with branch-heavy control flow, clamping each value to 63 before it is written into the record.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1D8A
name: finish_frame_value_adjustments
description: Finishes the frame value adjustment for the last entries, applying the neighbour-flag weights, clamping at 63 and returning at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1DA4
name: adjust_frame_values_head
description: Calls a routine for the leading frame, then walks the frame records applying the neighbour-flag weights and clamping at 63 until the end marker or the next boundary flag. Each value is written into its record.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1DAC
name: adjust_frame_values_tail
description: Walks the frame records applying the neighbour-flag weights and clamping values at 63, then finishes the last boundary and returns at the end marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1E12
name: compute_scaled_shifted_product
description: Multiplies the low word of the data register by the word passed in the other register, adds 16 to the low half of the product and returns it shifted right by five bits along with the high word.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1E1C
name: initialize_and_clear_buffers
description: Stores the start pointers of the unit's phoneme and frame buffers, clears a set of word fields, and zeroes six buffers in blocks of thirty-two entries. It then zeroes two more blocks of thirty-two entries.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1EE0
name: increment_counter_and_run_stages
description: Increments the unit's 16-bit counter and, unless the counter wrapped or became zero, calls four processing routines in order.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1F02
name: pack_phoneme_codes_into_buffer
description: Packs the phoneme codes from the input list into the output buffer, storing a flag nibble for each entry and recording the first and last positions that exceed the threshold. It stops at the end marker or after 128 entries.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1F58
name: pack_phoneme_codes_from_register
description: Variant of the packing pass that keeps the current code in a register, writing packed nibbles and flags into the output and recording boundary positions. It stops at the end marker or after 128 entries.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1F76
name: pack_phoneme_codes_loop
description: Packs the phoneme codes into the output buffer with the same flags and boundary recording as its neighbours. It returns when the end marker or the 128-entry limit is reached.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1FC0
name: set_flag_and_store_indices
description: Sets the group-end bit on the entry before the current index and stores the index in two unit fields, copying the first into the second when the counter is zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:1FD8
name: propagate_flags_backward
description: Counts the entries in the phoneme and frame buffers, marking special codes and setting flag bits from neighbouring codes. It then propagates the flag bits backward through the buffer and writes marker values at the last position.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2010
name: propagate_flags_from_index
description: Walks the entries marking special codes and flag bits, saves the buffer positions in the unit, and propagates the flag bits backward from the last index.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2032
name: propagate_flags_from_pointers
description: Variant of the flag marking pass that stores the current buffer pointers in the unit before the backward propagation.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2054
name: propagate_flags_backward_pass
description: Stores the three buffer pointers in the unit, clears the carry byte and runs the backward pass that propagates flag bits and moves marker values through the buffer.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:206C
name: propagate_flags_downward
description: Walks the buffer downward from the last index, ORing the carry byte into each entry. It moves marker values through the buffer when the code is the two or fourteen marker.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:208E
name: shift_marker_values_backward
description: Moves the marker value backward through the buffer from the current index, stopping when the index leaves the valid range, and clears the origin entry.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:20A8
name: swap_and_clear_byte_flags
description: Copies the entry at the source index to the destination index and clears the source when the two differ. It then steps backward through the buffer, ORing the carry byte into each entry and propagating the marker values.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:20BC
name: set_low_bit_over_count
description: Sets the low bit of every flag entry below the stored count, walking down from the top entry to index zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:20C4
name: set_low_bit_to_zero
description: Sets the low bit of each flag entry from the given index down to zero.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:20D0
name: or_mask_with_early_exit
description: Chooses a mask of four or eight from the control byte at the end of the list and ORs it into the entries, walking backward. It returns early when the frame flag bit is set on an entry.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:210A
name: set_mask_and_nibble_flag
description: ORs a mask of 176 into the entry, or 48 when the entry code is eight. When the counter is non-zero it clears the low nibble of the last flagged entry and sets its bit four.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2160
name: accumulate_table_entries
description: Calls a sequence of routines depending on two unit fields, then adds the stored short value to eight consecutive words of the table in the unit.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:21B8
name: compute_clamped_table_value
description: Computes a value from the position and a scaled step, clamps it between 125 and 165, and stores the low byte in the table at the given index.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:21F2
name: clamp_value_and_store_char
description: Clamps the value passed in the data register to a lower bound of 125 and an upper bound of 165, then stores the low byte at the table position given by the index.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:220C
name: adjust_pitch_across_segments
description: Derives a per-entry step from the segment length and adjusts the marked entries around the peak position. It smooths the differences between neighbours and then applies a scaled correction to each marked entry.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:22B6
name: adjust_table_values_loop
description: Computes the absolute difference between two table entries, scales it and adds the result to a destination entry. It then scans backward for flagged entries and applies a scaled adjustment, finishing with a correction on entries whose flag is set.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:230C
name: apply_final_pitch_corrections
description: Computes scaled values for each flagged entry from its level and writes them into two output tables. It applies an extra half-step correction when the flag bits call for it and copies the final entry.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2394
name: apply_pitch_corrections_loop
description: Walks the flagged entries backward, scaling their values and writing the corrected pitch and level bytes. It adds the final correction to the last entry and returns.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:23B2
name: compute_scaled_char_values
description: Walks the flagged entries backward, computing scaled character values from two tables and writing them into the destination tables. It applies the final correction at the end of the range.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:23CE
name: apply_segment_slope_adjustments
description: For each flagged segment, scales the two boundary values by a slope factor chosen from the segment length and adjusts the level table. A second pass raises the peak and fixed offsets on the entries that carry the marker bits.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:23E0
name: apply_segment_slope_loop
description: Applies the same segment slope adjustments to the flagged entries in a backward walk, then runs the peak and offset pass over the marked entries.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:240C
name: apply_slope_adjustments_nested
description: Performs the segment slope adjustments in nested loops, then runs the peak and offset pass over the entries that carry the marker bits.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:242A
name: apply_segment_slope_variant
description: Variant of the segment slope pass that holds its boundary indices in registers. It finishes with the peak and offset pass over the marked entries.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:244A
name: apply_pitch_slope_pass
description: Applies the segment slope scaling to the boundary entries and writes the corrected level and pitch bytes. It then runs the peak and offset pass over the entries that carry the marker bits.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:246A
name: apply_pitch_slope_pass_variant
description: Variant of the slope pass that updates the boundary level before scaling, then runs the peak and offset pass over the marked entries.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:248E
name: apply_pitch_slope_pass_tail
description: Finishes the slope pass for the last segment, updating the boundary value and writing the corrected level bytes, then runs the peak and offset pass.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2496
name: apply_pitch_slope_pass_entry
description: Applies the slope scaling at the segment boundaries and runs the peak and offset pass over the marked entries.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:24BE
name: apply_pitch_slope_stack_param
description: Applies the slope scaling using a slope value passed on the stack, updates the boundary entries, and runs the peak and offset pass over the marked entries.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:24DA
name: apply_pitch_slope_stack_variant
description: Repeats the stack-parameter slope scaling over the segments, then runs the peak and offset pass over the marked entries.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2506
name: apply_pitch_slope_stack_tail
description: Finishes the stack-parameter slope scaling for the last segment and runs the peak and offset pass over the marked entries.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2532
name: apply_pitch_slope_with_boundaries
description: Applies the slope scaling and boundary adjustments to the marked entries, then runs the peak and offset pass. Several callers use it as the common core of the pitch pass.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:25AC
name: apply_peak_offset_pass
description: Scales the peak level of the current segment and walks backward through the marked entries. It applies a fixed offset to entries with code four and a scaled correction to entries with code eight.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:25C0
name: apply_peak_offset_pass_register
description: Variant of the peak and offset pass that takes its scale factor from a register and walks the marked entries backward.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:25D4
name: apply_peak_offset_running_max
description: Tracks a running maximum over the frame values and writes a scaled peak correction into the entries. It then walks the marked entries backward, applying offset corrections for entries with codes four and eight.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:25F8
name: apply_scaled_offsets_by_nibble
description: Walks the entries backward and, for each entry whose high nibble is set, adds a scaled correction. The factor is chosen from the entry's top bit.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2608
name: apply_scaled_offsets_register
description: Repeats the nibble-driven scaled correction with the entry pointer held in a register, walking backward until the first entry.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2632
name: scale_buffer_by_signed_factor
description: Walks the buffer backward, skipping entries whose high nibble is zero, and multiplies each entry by a signed factor chosen from the source bit. The product updates a running accumulator that is added to the entries.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2642
name: smooth_pitch_curve_segments
description: Computes the differences between the level tables for each marked segment, halves them when the two levels disagree, and interpolates values across the segment's entries. It finishes by writing fixed default levels at the segment ends.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:26E8
name: smooth_pitch_curve_loop
description: Repeats the segment smoothing with interpolated values across each marked run, then writes the fixed default levels to the remaining entries.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:270C
name: smooth_pitch_curve_retry
description: Smooths the level differences across marked segments of the pitch curve, interpolating values between segment boundaries. It then writes fixed default levels and finishes the segment ends.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:273A
name: smooth_pitch_curve_stepwise
description: Repeats the segment smoothing one entry at a time, copying the interpolated values along each run and writing fixed default levels to the remaining entries.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2762
name: smooth_pitch_curve_entry
description: Calls a routine for the current entry and continues smoothing the marked segments, writing fixed default levels to the remaining entries.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2770
name: smooth_pitch_curve_from_entry
description: Continues the pitch curve smoothing from the entry reached by the previous pass, writing fixed default levels to the remaining entries.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:277E
name: finalize_pitch_defaults
description: Writes fixed default levels into the pitch table and then adjusts the last segment's end values using the scale factor from its code.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:278A
name: fill_pitch_defaults_backward
description: Fills the pitch table backward with a scaled value taken from the frame flags, then adjusts the final segment's end values with fixed defaults.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:27C8
name: interpolate_segment_levels
description: Interpolates the levels across the current segment and writes the segment's closing value. Fixed default levels are used when the segment code is not the special one.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:27F2
name: interpolate_segment_levels_tail
description: Interpolates the segment levels from a scale value held in a register, then writes the closing value from the largest entry or from fixed defaults.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:282C
name: write_segment_closing_value
description: Finds the largest level in the table and writes a scaled closing value and a zero flag into the segment's last entry.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2834
name: accumulate_bytes_and_write_results
description: Accumulates the bytes of the source area while keeping a running maximum, then writes a scaled value and a derived value into the destination buffers with a conditional copy.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:2864
name: apply_segment_slopes_backward
description: Walks the segments backward, applying scaled slope corrections to the level tables where the flags match. It applies a scaled end correction to the final entries.

key: operation stealth (1990)(u. s. gold)[cr pdx][a2](disk 1 of 3)/Operation Stealth (1990)(U. S. Gold)[cr PDX][a2](Disk 1 of 3).adf:DEVS/NARRATOR.DEVICE:0:287E
name: apply_segment_slopes_loop
description: Applies the same scaled slope corrections to the segments in a loop over the entries, then applies the end correction to the final entry.
